content: Hessafe guye ciimma ollaza doyza qulpenne gita sansalata ba kushen oykkida kiitanchchay saloppe duge wodhdhishin ta beyadis.
He daweza oykkidi shii layth qachchides; hessi dawezi Daabulosa woykko Xala7e geetettiza kase beni shooshshaza.
Shii layth gakkanaas izi kawoteththata baleththontta mala he kiitanchchazi daweza duge ciimma ollan yeggides; iza bolla gordidi maatame woththides; izi hessafe guuththa wodes birshettanaas bessees.

Hessafe guye tani algata beyadis; he algata bolla pirda pirdanaas godateththi isttas imettidayti uttidayta beyadis; qasseka Yesusa gishshas istti markkattida gishshassinne Xoossa qaalaa gishshas istta qoodhey qanxxettida asata shemppoka beyadis; heytantti do7azassinne iza mislezas goynnibeettenna; iza malataakka ba liiphe bolla gidiin ba kushe bolla woththonttayta; istti hayqoppe dendida Kirstoosara issife shii layth kawotida.
Hankko attida hayqeththati shii layththay polettana gakkanaas hayqoppe dendibeettenna; hessika hayqoppe koyro denththa.
Koyro denththan dizayti heyti anjjettidaytanne geeshshata. Istta bolla nam7anththo hayqos wolqqay deenna; istti Xoossa qeesetanne Kirstoosa qeeseta gidana; istti Kirstoosara shii layth kawotana.
He shii layththay polettida mala Xala7ey ba qashettidasoppe birshettana.
Alame bolla dizayti heytikka Googenne Maagooge geetettizayta baleththanaassinne istta olas ekki baanaas kezana; heytantta qooday abba achchan diza ace mala.
Istti kumeththa biittaa bolla laalettidi geeshshati dizasoyo dosettida katamayo giddoththida shin saloppe wodhdhida tamay istta dippi histti xuuggides.
Kase istta baleththida Daabulosi he do7azinne wordo nabezi dizasoy diinen eexxiza tama abba giddon yegettida; istti heen qammanne gallas mernaappe mernaa gakkanaas xuugettana.
Hessafe guye issi gita booththa alganne he algaa bolla uttidayssa beyadis; biittaynne saloy iza sinththafe baqatida shin istti biidi gelanasoy beettibeenna.
He algaza sinththan hayqqida cimatanne naateththata beyadis; maxaafatikka doyettida; hara de7o maxaafaykka doyettides; hayqqidaytikka maxaafatan kase xaafetti diza ba ooso ooso mala pirda ekkida.
Abbayka ba garsan diza hayqeththata immides; hayqoynne Duufoy qasse kase hayqqidi ba giddon dizayta immida; issi issi asi ba ooso ooso mala pirda ekkides.
Hayqoynne Duufoy tama abba giddo yegettida; he tama abbazi nam7anththo hayqo.
Iza sunththi de7o maxaafan xaafettonttaadey wurikka tama abbaan yegettides.
